sentences.text: By the present writ petition, the petitioner is seeking a direction towards respondent No.3 to expedite the proceeding of Case No. 26/A-22-82/2023-24 pending before it.
2. Learned counsel appearing for the petitioner would submit that the petitioner is the owner of land bearing Khasra No. 628/2 admeasuring 0.5 acres situated at Village Belsari.

He would submit that out of the said land, 0.38 acres of the land has been acquired by the respondents' authorities under the provision of the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013 (henceforth 'the Act, 2013').

entities.text: Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: Thereafter, the award has been passed.

Being aggrieved by the insufficient compensation, the petitioner moved an application under Section 3G before the concerned respondent No.3 on 16/11/2023, but till date no action has been taken by the Authorities,
despite the fact the petitioner is running from pillars to post for redressal of his grievance, but the same does not fructify.
3.

Learned counsel for the State, on instructions, would submit that if the application of the petitioner is pending consideration before respondent No.3, the same shall be considered and decided in accordance with law within a stipulated period.
4. I have heard learned counsel for the parties and perused the documents.

5. It is not in dispute that the land of the petitioner has been acquired by the respondent authorities and being aggrieved with inadequate compensation, the petitioner moved an application before respondent No. 3 on 16/11/2023 (Annexure-P/5).

Thus, the respondent No.3 is directed to consider and decide the pending application of the petitioner within a period of 3 months from the date of receipt of copy of this order in accordance with law and on its own merits and pass a reasoned and speaking order by assigning cogent reasons.
6. With the aforesaid directions, the writ petition is disposed of.

7. The petitioner is liberty to apprise the order of this Court to respondent No. 3.
Sd/-
